knowledge.name: Greetings and Numbers
knowledge.explanation: 能用英语问候并介绍自己的年龄。

knowledge.name: Greetings
knowledge.explanation: 掌握 Hello / Good morning / Goodbye 等问候语。

knowledge.name: Numbers 1-10
knowledge.explanation: 能听、说、读 1~10 的英文数字。

knowledge.name: Classroom English
knowledge.explanation: 听懂并回应 Stand up / Sit down / Open your book 等课堂指令。

questions.analysis: 别人说 Hello 时，用 Hello 回应。

questions.stem: — How old are you? — I am six ____ old.
questions.analysis: 表达年龄用「数字 + years old」。
Good morning 表示「早上好」，用于上午见面时问候。

questions.stem: Which of the following are greetings?（  ）
questions.analysis: Hello、Good morning、Goodbye 都是问候或告别语；Stand up 是课堂指令。

questions.stem: Introduce yourself with two sentences: your name and your age.

answer.value: My name is Li Ming. I am seven years old.

questions.analysis: 参考表达：My name is ... / I am ... years old. 姓名与年龄表达正确即可。
